flags.q: In the Neer classification of proximal humerus fractures, a segment counts as a 'part' when it is displaced by more than:
flags.issue: The Neer classification defines a segment as displaced if it is >2 mm or angulated >10°. The marked answer (C) is incorrect.

flags.q: Recombinant BMP-2 has FDA approval for:
flags.key: Acute open tibial shaft fractures treated with intramedullary nailing
flags.issue: rhBMP‑2 is NOT FDA‑approved for tibial shaft fractures; the only approved indication in orthopaedics is anterior lumbar spine fusion. The marked answer A is incorrect.

flags.q: A 15-year-old has night pain in the proximal femur relieved by NSAIDs. CT shows a 1 cm lucent nidus with surrounding sclerosis. Treatment of choice:
flags.issue: The only listed treatment is RFA; however standard practice for an osteoid osteoma first‑line is NSAIDs, which are not an option. The marked answer is questionable but no unambiguous error in the question wording.

flags.q: Jersey finger (FDP avulsion) most commonly involves the:
flags.issue: Jersey finger typically involves the middle finger; the marked answer (ring finger) is wrong.

flags.q: The nerve most commonly injured in an extension-type supracondylar humerus fracture is the:
flags.issue: Extension‑type supracondylar fractures most commonly injure the radial nerve; the answer marked as AIN is incorrect.
